اغترفن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَفْنَ (iḡtarafna) /iɣ.ta.raf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اُغْتُرِفْنَ (uḡturifna) /uɣ.tu.rif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اِغْتَرِفْنَ (iḡtarifna) /iɣ.ta.rif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
